Verpakt als sport, spel en creatieve activiteiten. Zodat kinderen langzaam weer kunnen én durven geloven in de toekomst. Spelenderwijs halen we de oorlog uit een kind.

War Child Nederland Zoekt Een

Data Analyst

"Oplossingsgerichte data expert die cijfers inzet voor impact"

Over de functie

Praktische, oplossingsgerichte Data Analyst die data vertaalt naar acties: je verzamelt, valideert en combineert operationele en financiële gegevens, ontwikkelt gebruiksvriendelijke Power BI‑dashboards en Salesforce‑rapportages, monitort pipeline‑prestaties en forecasts en levert heldere, onderbouwde aanbevelingen en auditeerbare data‑exports zodat management en teams snel en betrouwbaar kunnen sturen op fondsenwerving, projecten en investeringen.

Je bent als Data Analyst onderdeel van het Data team en rapporteert direct aan de Head of Finance, Data & CRM.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Kerntaken en verantwoordelijkheden

Analyseer operationele, fundraising- en financiële data en vertaal inzichten naar heldere, uitvoerbare aanbevelingen voor MT, Fundraising, Finance en Operations.
Ontwikkel, onderhoud en beheer dashboards en rapportagetools (voornamelijk Power BI en Excel) die KPI’s, campagneprestaties, inkomstenprognoses en operationele metrics volgen; zorg voor performance, gebruiksvriendelijkheid en documentatie.
Definieer, documenteer en onderhoud een single source of truth voor funding‑ en operationele KPI’s: eenduidige definities, berekeningsmethoden, eigenaarschap en versiebeheer zodat cijfers vergelijkbaar en betrouwbaar zijn.
Leid de maandelijkse en kwartaalcyclus voor funding performance: verzamel, valideer, reconcilieer en consolideer pipeline‑ en inkomensdata; produceer beknopte highlight‑rapporten en dashboards voor MT en Fundraising.
Monitor pipeline‑conversie en conversiemetrics per donor, campagne en opportunity‑stage; lever forecasting‑inputs en signaleer materiële risico’s en bottlenecks tijdig.
Beheer CRM‑rapportage en geautomatiseerde exports (Salesforce): ontwerp en bouw rapporten, automatiseer exports en integraties met financiële/operationele systemen om handwerk te verminderen; houd audit trails en documentatie bij.
Implementeer en onderhoud datakwaliteitscontroles en validatiechecks; reconcilieer afwijkingen met Finance/CRM en werk samen met Quality Assurance bij compliance‑controles en audit‑voorbereiding.
Bereid gestandaardiseerde, auditeerbare data‑exports en IATI‑compatibele bestanden voor waar nodig voor donorrapportage en audits; zorg dat output voldoet aan donor‑ en organisatienormen.
Ondersteun Fundraising en NL Programme teams technisch en analytisch bij segmentatie, donoranalyse, campagne‑reviews en scenario‑modellering; vertaal analyses naar concrete acties.
Verhoog de datageletterdheid binnen WCNL door trainingen, gebruiksvriendelijke handleidingen en operationele support; faciliteer consistent gebruik van dashboards en rapporten.
Draag bij aan continue verbetering van datamodellen, rapportage‑architectuur en documentatie: identificeer en implementeer automatisering, performance‑optimalisaties en procesverbeteringen.
Vertegenwoordig WCNL bij afstemming met Alliance/Member data‑standaarden: pas relevante definities toe, communiceer WCNL‑behoeften en zorg dat lokale rapportage compatibel blijft met bredere standaarden.
Werk strikt volgens data governance, privacy‑ en safeguarding‑regels; behandel donor‑, partner‑ en beneficiarydata met hoge nauwkeurigheid, vertrouwelijkheid en integriteit.

Jouw profiel

Bachelor of gelijkwaardig werk‑ en denkniveau.
Analytisch, nauwkeurig en kwaliteitsgericht; werkt gestructureerd en met oog voor detail.
Sterke advies‑ en communicatievaardigheden; maakt complexe data begrijpelijk voor niet‑technische stakeholders.
Samenwerkingsgericht en proactief in procesverbetering.
Goede kennis van principes rond data governance, privacy en safeguarding.
Uitstekend schriftelijk en mondeling Engels; Nederlands is een pré.

Ervaring

3–5 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring in data‑analyse en rapportage.
Hands‑on ervaring met Power BI (dashboardontwikkeling, DAX) en gevorderde Excel.
Praktische ervaring met CRM‑rapportage en geautomatiseerde exports/integraties (bijv. Salesforce).
Ervaring met coderen en basis scripting (DAX en/of R; HTML is een pré).
Ervaring met opzetten en uitvoeren van datakwaliteitchecks, reconciliaties en audit‑voorbereiding (inclusief IATI waar relevant).
Ervaring met maandelijkse/kwartaalrapportages voor funding performance, pipeline‑forecasting en management‑dashboards.
Aantoonbare ervaring met het vertalen van analyses naar concrete, uitvoerbare aanbevelingen en het presenteren daarvan aan MT of andere niet‑technische teams.
Ervaring met documentatie en versiebeheer van KPI‑definities, berekeningsmethoden en rapportagestructuren.
Ervaring met fondsenwervingsdatabases of NGO‑fundraisingdata is een pré.

Wat wij bieden

Salaris varieert van € 3.801 tot € 4.727 bruto per maand, op basis van 40 uur per week (het exacte bedrag wordt bepaald door de jaren van je relevante werkervaring);
8% vakantietoeslag op basis van het jaarsalaris;
Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 32-40 uur;
29 vakantiedagen per jaar op fulltime basis (waarvan 3 vooraf vastgestelde vrije dagen);
Een geluksdag, die je spontaan kan inzetten om iets te doen waar je energie van krijgt.
Een volledig door War Child Nederland betaalde pensioenregeling;
Netto tegemoetkoming in de thuiswerk -en reiskosten volgens ons hybride werkbeleid;
Maandelijkse mobiele telefoonvergoeding van €25 netto per maand;
Verschillende secundaire voorwaarden gefocust op persoonlijke ontwikkeling en welzijn;
Goede sfeer, toffe collega's en natuurlijk het betekenisvolle doel van ons werk!

Solliciteren

Wij nodigen je uit om zo snel mogelijk, maar uiterlijk vóór 22 November 2026 te solliciteren.

Upload je CV (maximaal twee pagina’s) en motivatie. Je kan je motivatie delen in Word, PDF of foto-format. Sollicitaties worden overwogen wanneer deze binnen komen en we beginnen met een gesprek zodra geschikte kandidaat(en) solliciteert.

Is dit niet jouw droombaan? Steun War Child Nederland door deze vacature te delen met je netwerk!

Door te solliciteren op deze vacature, verklaar je dat de verklaringen en informatie die je in je sollicitatie hebt opgenomen zijn juist, volledig en te goeder trouw gedaan. Je begrijpt dat het geven van een verkeerde voorstelling van zaken, onjuiste informatie en het achterhouden van informatie een reden is om je sollicitatie af te wijzen, een aanbod of benoeming in te trekken en, indien deze is al aanvaard, dit kan leiden tot sancties, zoals, maar niet uitsluitend, ontslag op staande voet. Daarnaast begrijp je dat je een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) moet overleggen en dat, als je die niet kan overleggen, er geen arbeidsrelatie kan ontstaan.

War Child Nederland is een internationale organisatie en we zijn toegewijd om een diverse en inclusieve werkgever te zijn. Wij werven onze nieuwe collega’s op basis van hun talenten, competenties en gedeelde waarden; daarbij letten we niet op de leeftijd, geslacht of genderidentiteit, ras, kleur, etniciteit, geloof, cultuur, seksuele oriëntatie, fysieke beperking, etc.

Veiligheid van kinderen en jeugd is voor War Child Nederland essentieel. War Child Nederland tolereert en accepteert dan ook geen enkele vorm van misbruik. Dit onderwerp komt aan bod in onze werving- en selectieprocedures. Bovendien vragen wij alle geselecteerde kandidaten aan te tonen dat ze op de hoogte zijn van, en zich committeren aan de minimale standaarden die van toepassing zijn in de ontwikkelings- en humanitaire context, zoals humanitaire normen en waarden, Sphere Humanitarian Charter, normen in de Humanitarian Standards Partnership, Core Humanitarian Standard, internationaal humanitair recht, de gedragscode voor het Internationale Rode Kruis en de Rode Halvemaan Beweging, en Goede Doelen (ngo’s) in rampenbestrijding en de 6 IASC basisprincipes ten aanzien van seksuele exploitatie en misbruik.

Disclaimer

Alleen sollicitaties die via onze website binnenkomen, worden in behandeling genomen.
Indien we voor de genoemde sluitingsdatum een geschikte kandidaat hebben gevonden, kan het zijn dat we de vacature eerder dan de vermelde sluitingsdatum van onze website verwijderen. Reacties die na sluitingsdatum binnenkomen, nemen we dan helaas niet meer in behandeling.
De sluitingsdatum kan verlengd worden tijdens ons selectieproces. Indien je nog niets van ons vernomen hebt, nemen we je sollicitatie mee in de verlengde procedure.

Over ons

Onze organisatie

War Child is een dynamische organisatie waar een informele sfeer heerst en waar veel ruimte is voor creativiteit en eigen initiatief. Het imago dat War Child extern uitdraagt, is een blauwdruk van het werk op het hoofdkantoor: het is dynamisch, vernieuwend, integer en gericht op het behalen van resultaten tegen lage kosten. War Child besteedt zoveel mogelijk budget aan het helpen van kinderen in oorlog en doet er daarom alles aan om de kosten zo laag mogelijk te houden. Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn op het niveau van de Nederlandse NGO sector. Het kantoor is gevestigd in de Amsterdamse wijk Watergraafsmeer. We werken in een hybride vorm, met de combinatie van thuis en op kantoor.

Veiligheid

War Child werkt vanuit humanitaire waarden en normen. Van mogelijke nieuwe collega’s vragen we hetzelfde. Voor War Child staat de veiligheid van de kinderen en jongeren die we steunen voorop. We bestrijden elke vorm van misbruik. Omdat we willen dat kinderen en jongeren geen enkel risico lopen komt dit uitgebreid aan bod bij de werving van nieuwe collega’s. Als onderdeel van sollicitaties vragen we daarom om referenties naar aanleiding van het Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme en een recente Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG).

Gelijke kansen

War Child droomt dat alle kinderen in vrede kunnen leven, wie ze ook zijn en waar ze ook opgroeien. Daarom is War Child trots dat we gelijke kansen bieden aan iedereen die met ons wil werken. We bevorderen diversiteit en willen dat iedereen zich bij ons thuis voelt. War Child selecteert mogelijke nieuwe collega’s ongeacht hun gender, ras, nationaliteit, beperking, leeftijd of seksuele voorkeur.

Sollicitaties

We besteden zoveel mogelijk van onze inkomsten aan de ondersteuning van kinderen en jongeren. Daarom werken we efficiënt. Dat betekent dat we alleen sollicitaties bekijken die we via onze websites ontvangen. Mochten we een geschikte persoon vinden vóór de sluitingsdatum, verwijderen we de vacature van onze websites. jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Delinea

Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Data Engineer & Analyst

About The Role

We’re hiring a Data Engineer & Analyst for a hybrid role in Mexico City, with three days per week in the office. You’ll manage data pipelines, build Streamlit in Snowflake apps, and turn operational data into insights for Cloud Engineering and other stakeholders.

What you’ll do

Manage and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Fivetran for ingestion and Airflow for orchestration. This includes onboarding new data sources, building and updating DAGs, monitoring runs, and resolving failures.
Design and build Streamlit in Snowflake apps for incident reporting, alert trends, on-call and operational metrics, and other Cloud Engineering use cases.
Analyze operational data, including incident volume, mean time to resolution (MTTR), and alert noise, and share clear, actionable findings with stakeholders.
Work with existing Snowflake tables and views. When new semantic or aggregate layers are needed, build them according to DSA modeling conventions and submit them for team review.
Follow DSA standards for repository structure, naming, role-based access control (RBAC), secrets handling, warehouse usage, and environment promotion (dev → test → prod).
Use the team’s Git-based CI/CD process, including Snowflake CLI or an equivalent tool, for all pipeline, app, and SQL changes. Manual deployments are not permitted.
Monitor pipeline and app health in Datadog, configure alerts, and respond to data issues in accordance with team engineering practices.
Improve performance and reduce query costs through caching, efficient SQL, and appropriately sized warehouses.
Gather requirements from Cloud Engineering, refine the user experience with users, and deliver improvements in short cycles.
Document apps, pipelines, data dependencies, and runbooks.

Must-have Qualifications

4+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data analytics, including 2+ years of hands-on experience with Snowflake, covering SQL, Snowpark, RBAC, tasks and streams, and warehouse management.
A solid understanding of the Snowflake development lifecycle, including Git workflows, pull requests, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and environment promotion.
Hands-on experience building and managing ETL/ELT pipelines with tools such as Airflow and Fivetran.
Working knowledge of engineering and observability practices, including monitoring, alerting, logging, and incident response, using tools such as Datadog. Familiarity with incident data from PagerDuty, Opsgenie, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar platforms.
Production experience building Streamlit apps, ideally Streamlit in Snowflake.
Strong Python and advanced SQL skills.
A strong analytical mindset, with the ability to translate business questions into metrics and explain findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Comfort working within established team standards and code review processes, and suggesting improvements to them.
Ability to work independently and regularly demonstrate progress.

Nice-to-have Qualifications

Experience with dbt or Snowflake dynamic tables.
Familiarity with Snowflake Cortex, including LLM functions and Cortex Analyst/Search, for querying incident data in plain language.
Prior experience with SRE, cloud operations, or FinOps reporting.
Experience using Terraform to manage Snowflake objects.

Why work at Delinea?

We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.
We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.
What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do
Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments
Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team
Ownership - We take initiative and follow through
Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment
Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.

Additional Contributions: Perform additional duties as assigned to support team and organizational objectives.

This isn’t just about ticking off tasks on a list. It's about making a significant, positive change in BECU’s journey, where your contributions are valued, and your growth is continually fostered.

What You’ll Gain

Advanced Skill Building: Deepen your expertise in enterprise data architecture, cloud technologies, advanced analytics, data modeling, and business intelligence solutions.
Strategic Influence: Work directly with business and technology leaders to shape data solutions that align with organizational priorities and long-term objectives.
Collaborative Innovation: Join a team that values curiosity, problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and new approaches to turning data into meaningful outcomes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent work or educational experience.
Minimum 7 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, data management, or a related discipline, including advanced experience as a BI power user and data consumer.
Advanced proficiency in SQL, relational and NoSQL data modeling, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Demonstrated ability to bridge business and technical teams, translating complex data requirements into strategic and operational solutions that drive business decisions.
Strong understanding of cloud computing, data engineering principles, and enterprise data architecture, with experience using Azure, DataOps, JIRA, or comparable agile development tools and technologies.
Proven ability to plan, organize, and execute complex data initiatives using established project management methodologies.

Desired Qualifications

Advanced degree in a related discipline.
Advanced proficiency with Python, Alteryx, or similar data manipulation and analytical tools.

JOIN THE JOURNEY

Ready to make an indelible impact? Eager to be part of a collaborative and innovative team where your ideas and contributions don’t just fill a role but fuel the growth and success of BECU? This is more than a job – it’s a chance to elevate your career, skills, and future, all while contributing to the robust operational landscape of BECU.

Embrace the opportunity to grow with us. Apply now, bring your expertise to the table, and let’s achieve excellence together at BECU. Your journey of influence, innovation, and impactful contribution starts now. #BECU #YourGrowth #BECUJourney

jobs.description:
As a member of the Knowledge Management & Innovation Department, the KM Research Analyst conducts sophisticated legal and non-legal research to respond to firm-wide reference and research requests from attorneys, administration and staff.

Please note: this position will operate from 9/9:30am - 6/6:30pm Eastern Time

Essential Functions

Monitors workflow; responds and completes department requests.
Provides comprehensive legal and business research using a variety of on-line and print resources, including proper use of AI tools.
Conducts complex substantive legal research, precedent document searching, expert witness research, legislative history research, judicial research, docket, and analytics searching.
Creates targeted, custom alerts to monitor developments in the law, docket tracks, and litigation searches.
Precisely, intelligently, and promptly communicates the results of research requests to the requestors.
Provides general support for KM research tools and resources (i.e. Westlaw Precision, Practical Law, and other related platforms).

Additional Functions

Works on special projects (i.e., collection development) as assigned.

Education

QUALIFICATIONS (EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES):

Bachelor’s degree in related field required. Masters in Library & Information Science or Juris Doctor a plus.

Experience

Minimum of three years of legal and business research experience in a legal, corporate or professional services environment.
Experience using AI tools a plus.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Thorough and advanced knowledge of legal research and general business research
Knowledge of and ability to use on-line resources including AI functionality within tools. Resources include: Westlaw Precision/Practical Law with AI modules, Bloomberg Law, PACER, and other types of web-based services, including IP, corporate and securities research tools as well as the Microsoft suite of products.
Ability to synthesize relevant information needed for high-level decision making.
Excellent communication skills with particular emphasis on written communication
Ability to multitask, manage time, establish priorities, respond to emergencies and deal with individuals with patience and diplomacy.
Ability to maintain a service-oriented attitude, remaining poised under pressure.
Self-motivated, detail oriented and organized with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

This job operates in a clerical, office setting. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

Sedentary work: Exertion of physical strength to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects up to 10 pounds. Work involves sitting most of the time. Walking and standing is often necessary in carrying out job duties.

new_jobs.title: Time & Attendance Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Project Manager - Time & Attendance (T&A) Brazil

Division: Weir Minerals

Location: Brazil (remote)

What We Do At Weir

We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining.

Make your impact

As the T&A Project Manager for Brazil,
you will lead the successful delivery of Time & Attendance solutions across Brazil, driving implementation activities and execution throughout the project lifecycle.

This is a hands-on delivery leadership role,
combining project governance with active involvement in day-to-day project execution. Acting as the primary coordination point between business stakeholders, implementation partners, and global program leadership, you will manage vendor delivery, stakeholder engagement, and business readiness activities to ensure successful, compliant, and sustainable T&A implementations

What You’ll Do

Project Planning & Governance: Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, governance frameworks, and documentation, ensuring alignment with global program objectives, regional business needs, and implementation partner methodologies.
Project Delivery & Vendor Management: Lead end-to-end T&A implementations across North America, coordinating cross-functional teams, implementation partners, and technology vendors to deliver all project phases, from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, go-live, and transition to ongoing support.
Risk, RAIDD & Readiness Management: Manage RAIDD governance, proactively identifying risks, issues, actions, decisions, and dependencies, while overseeing mitigation plans, stage-gate readiness assessments, operational preparedness, and go-live approvals across multiple countries and business units.
Change Management & Adoption: Partner with change, communications, and training teams to drive business readiness, user adoption, process standardization, and successful implementation of future-state workforce management processes, balancing global standards with regional operational and compliance requirements.
Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement: Provide project reporting and executive communications, including status updates, milestone tracking, project health indicators, resource and budget impacts, governance materials, and escalation of critical issues, while building strong relationships with business and leadership stakeholders.
Safety First: Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero harm behaviors in support of our drive towards developing a world-class safety culture.

What You’ll Bring

Must-haves:

2 - 5 years leading Time & Attendance (T&A), Workforce Management (WFM), or Timekeeping system implementations
Experience delivering end-to-end projects across multiple countries, including vendor and implementation partner management.
Knowledge of Brazilian payroll processes, labor legislation, tax requirements, compliance obligations, and integrations between Payroll, T&A, HRIS, and Finance systems.
Proficiency with workforce management platforms such as GeoVictoria, Ahgora,ADP eTime, ADP Essential, ADP EZ Labour, UKG, WorkForce Software, Dayforce, SAP SuccessFactors Time, Workday Time Tracking, or similar solutions.
Strong understanding of T&A processes, Payroll/HRIS integrations, RAIDD governance, project reporting, and executive stakeholder communication.
Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and spoken).

Nice-to-haves:

Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2 Practitioner, Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), or equivalent project management certification
Agile, Scrum, or other project delivery certifications
Experience supporting payroll service delivery models, including exposure to Brazilian collective bargaining agreements and workforce management practices.
Familiarity with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, Workday, Oracle HCM, or similar HR technology platforms.
Experience working in global transformation initiatives within complex, matrixed organizations.
Spanish is a plus.

Why join Weir?

We live our values we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.

We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end-to-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies.

We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives.

Benefits

Competitive pay
Access to global inclusion networks
Regional and team-specific benefits
Sharebuilder scheme
Wellness support for you and your family
Collaboration with global teams

Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. We’re building the next chapter of AI-native craft and creativity - where craft and technology meet. Our unified platform bridges the gap between AI capabilities and human creativity, and lets professional creatives and designers harness the power of the world’s leading AI models without losing precision, expression, or soul. Together, we’re building tools that help people move faster without sacrificing quality, precision, or craft - a platform where AI supports creativity instead of flattening it.

We’re looking for a scrappy, hands-on AI Product Technical Program Manager to join Figma Weave as the team’s first TPM. You’ll partner with Engineering, Product, and Design to turn ambiguous customer needs and new AI capabilities into reliable creative workflows. You’ll lead programs across the AI model lifecycle, usage economics, and products like the Weave API. You’ll get close to the architecture, help teams make informed technical tradeoffs, and stay accountable through launch and adoption. You’ll also build AI workflows and automation yourself to help the team move faster.

This full-time role can be based in our New York hub or remotely on the East Coast of the United States. You’ll join a team spread across the United States, Europe, and Tel Aviv, with occasional travel to work alongside Figma Weave partners in Tel Aviv.

What you’ll do at Figma Weave:

Lead model lifecycle management across image, video, editing, enhancement, audio/lip-sync, 3D, and vector models, using the existing evaluation process to drive new model integration, launch, updates, and deprecation
Make tradeoffs around quality, reliability, latency, cost, and capacity clear to the decision owners
Track model limitations, integration issues, and provider dependencies through fixes, rollout, and follow-up
Work with Engineering, Partnerships, and Finance on provider agreements, quotas, rate limits, and capacity commitments so Weave can support product growth and launch demand. Bring in Product, Legal, and Security to resolve dependencies
Manage AI costs, capacity, and unit economics across 10+ providers and 50+ models. Forecast usage and spend, plan provider capacity for launches, and work with engineers on fallback options
Build things that make work less work. Improve process design and build AI workflows and automation that help the team move faster. Use APIs, scripts, or data queries to improve program visibility, streamline processes, and remove recurring bottlenecks
Lead horizontal product programs that span Weave teams, such as the Weave API. Understand how API contracts, authentication, permissions, asynchronous execution, and usage limits affect delivery. Coordinate dependencies across Weave and Figma, work through technical blockers, and follow the program through testing, release, and adoption
Lead cross-functional technical readiness for Config and other major launches. Work with engineering leads on end-to-end workflow testing, provider capacity, monitoring, and rollback plans. Bring together Support, Legal, Marketing, and other launch partners, make risks and go/no-go decisions clear, and follow through on customer issues and incident action items after release

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

Scrappiness and adaptability: You get into the details and take practical steps to move work forward. You can investigate a problem, partner with your engineering counterparts on a solution, or build a quick prototype without waiting for a perfect plan. You adjust when priorities change and follow through on what you start
Third-party AI model integration: You’ve led programs that bring third-party AI models into a product and keep them working. You can use evaluation findings and usage data to drive decisions across Engineering, Product, and Partnerships, including tradeoffs around quality, reliability, latency, cost, capacity, and unit economics
AI-enabled process design and automation: Hands-on experience building lightweight processes by leveraging AI workflows, automation, or internal tools
Technical judgment and hands-on problem solving: You can follow a workflow from the user interface through backend services and external model APIs. You reason about latency, throughput, rate limits, retries, and failure modes with engineers. You’ve managed AI cost structures, including usage and spend, pricing negotiations, and capacity planning
AI product program delivery and ownership: You’ve led customer-facing technical programs with cross-functional partners, from an ambiguous need through launch and adoption. You judge success by whether the product works for customers and delivers the intended result

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

You’ve been an early TPM or worked at a startup, where you helped engineering teams plan and ship without adding more process than they needed

new_jobs.title: Order Resolution Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Positition

The Order Resolution Program Manager builds and leads the Order Resolution Program (ORP), a national program that helps ensure patients receive the testing their physicians have ordered. When an order encounters a barrier, such as an unreachable patient, an incorrect phone number, a patient with unanswered questions about their test, or a step that requires clinic involvement, this role makes sure the right people take the right action so care is not delayed. Many of these patients are navigating a cancer diagnosis, and the program exists to support them and the Patient Coordinators who care for them.

As the program's founding owner , the Program Manager exercises independent judgment to assess the current landscape, resolve complex cases directly, and determine what the program needs to succeed, including whether and how to expand the team. The role is hands-on by design: the Program Manager works open cases alongside Patient Coordinators to understand where and why orders stall, then uses that firsthand insight and program data to set strategy, define standards, and guide leadership decisions.

The Program Manager partners across Patient Services, Territory Managers, Clinical Oncology Specialists, Patient Coordinators, Inside Sales Managers, Regional Directors, and Operations Managers, earning alignment through expertise and sound judgment rather than direct authority.

Primary Responsibilities

Program Strategy & Ownership

Own the Order Resolution Program end-to-end across all national regions, independently assessing the current landscape, including case volume, root causes, regional variation, and existing workflows, to determine where patient orders are most at risk of delay.
Develop a data-supported program roadmap and staffing recommendation for Patient Services leadership, including headcount requirements, staffing structure, timeline, and whether process or tooling solutions would better serve patients.
Define the program operating model, including case ownership, escalation criteria, service timelines, handoff protocols, and quality standards, and adjust it as the program matures.
Lead the design of the team structure, role definitions, hiring profile, onboarding, and performance expectations for future team members.

Case Resolution & Patient Care Support

Exercise independent judgment to evaluate open ORP cases, determine the root cause of each barrier, and develop a tailored resolution strategy that accounts for the clinical context, the patient's circumstances, and available resources.
Work complex and high-priority cases directly, including researching LIMS, paper orders, and patient outreach tools to locate missing or updated contact information, and decide whether a case calls for administrative resolution, clinic education or engagement, or escalation.
Partner with Patient Coordinators to support patient outreach, providing guidance on how to approach each case and, where appropriate, connecting with patients directly so that questions about their orders are answered and care can move forward.
Determine when to escalate a case to the clinic, engage the field team, or close it, and document the rationale so any subsequent owner can continue seamlessly.
Maintain a real-time view of all open cases, including status, owner, next action, and age, and follow up consistently to confirm actions are completed and patients are not left waiting.

Analytics & Performance Reporting

Design, build, and maintain the ORP reporting infrastructure, including dashboards, KPI scorecards, and regional trend analysis, and define the metrics used to measure program success.
Report regularly to Patient Services leadership on case volume, resolution rates, time to resolution, and order completion outcomes, translating data into clear insights about what is working, what is not, and what should change.
Analyze recurring barriers, such as common reasons patients cannot be reached or questions that arise repeatedly, and develop recommendations that reduce the number of patients whose orders require intervention in the first place.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Process Improvement

Partner with Territory Managers, Clinical Oncology Specialists, Associate Clinical Oncology Specialists, and Patient Coordinators to set clear expectations, communicate promptly, and share accountability on every open case.
Partner with Inside Sales Managers, Regional Directors, and Operations Managers to align program priorities, resolve regional barriers, and ensure teams understand their role in supporting patient orders.
Serve as the subject matter expert for ORP, providing guidance and consultation to field and operations partners and developing best practices, training, and standard work that can be adopted nationally.
Identify systemic process gaps and bring structured, data-backed recommendations to leadership, including changes to workflows, status definitions, tooling, and cross-team handoffs, with the patient experience as the guiding lens.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, life sciences, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience in a role requiring independent judgment, program ownership, and decision-making in a healthcare or clinical operations environment.
5 or more years of experience in healthcare operations, patient services, program or project management, or a comparable environment, with demonstrated ownership of a program, workflow, or initiative from assessment through execution.
Demonstrated ability to assess a complex operating landscape, identify root causes, and develop and present a data-supported recommendation, including resourcing and staffing needs, to senior leadership.
Proven ability to independently assess multi-variable situations and determine the appropriate course of action without direct supervision, particularly in patient-facing or clinically sensitive contexts.
Demonstrated ability to influence and drive accountability across cross-functional teams, including field, sales, and operations leaders, without direct authority.
Strong analytical capability, including building performance reporting, interpreting trends, and communicating findings clearly to leadership; advanced MS Excel or equivalent skills required.
Experience in a call center, patient outreach, or high-volume case management environment (inbound and outbound).
Proficiency in CRM platforms, case tracking systems, and data tools; familiarity with skip tracing tools and LIMS is a strong plus.
Prior experience leading, coaching, or building a team is preferred. Background in patient coordination or another patient-facing healthcare role is strongly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Technical

Program and project management expertise, including scoping, planning, prioritization, milestone tracking, and stakeholder management.
Specialized knowledge of healthcare operations, patient services workflows, and clinical coordination sufficient to evaluate case scenarios and develop resolution strategies without relying on standardized scripts.
Advanced proficiency in CRM platforms, case tracking systems, and reporting tools, with the ability to design KPI dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into program performance and patient order outcomes.
Strong quantitative skills, including comfort working with large data sets to identify trends, build business cases, and model staffing and capacity needs.
Experience with skip tracing tools and multi-database research methods, and with process documentation and standard operating procedure development.

Behavioral

Exercises sound, independent judgment consistently, treating each case and each program decision as a situation requiring individualized analysis.
Builds before being asked: sees what a new program needs, takes ownership of the decision, and moves forward without waiting to be told something is off track.
Balances urgency and care: moves quickly because patients are waiting, and makes thoughtful decisions because the stakes are real.
Thinks like a program owner and acts like a teammate: comfortable working individual cases to learn the work, and equally comfortable stepping back to set strategy and advise leadership.
Earns credibility with cross-functional partners through expertise, clear communication, and follow-through, and uses it to drive action across teams they do not directly control.
Coaches and develops others, and is ready to build and lead a team as the program grows.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

This is a primarily remote position. Occasional on-site attendance may be required for planning sessions, leadership reviews, or business needs.
Duties are performed in a home office or professional office setting and require the ability to use a computer keyboard, communicate over the telephone, and read printed and digital material.
This role may require working outside standard business hours at times to address time-sensitive case situations or program needs.

Travel

Minimal travel required. Occasional travel (estimated less than 15%) may be required for national leadership meetings, regional business reviews, or planning sessions.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. College Board - Global Strategy & Talent

Location: This is a remote role.

Candidates who live near CB offices may choose to work remotely or in a hybrid model (Tuesday/Wednesday in office). All employees are expected to travel occasionally for in-person business needs.

Role Type: This is a full-time position.

About The Team

At College Board, the Talent team is the engine behind our people who in turn power our mission to positively impact millions of students worldwide. We are a mission-driven group dedicated to enabling 2,000+ employees to do the most meaningful, high-impact work of their careers. As the world of work continues to evolve, the Talent team plays a critical role in helping College Board adapt with clarity, consistency, and purpose.

Guided by a clear philosophy, we design with the end user in mind, use data to solve real problems, innovate thoughtfully, and communicate directly and honestly. Our work is grounded in building high-performing teams, strengthening accountable leadership, and creating the conditions for every employee to thrive.

This role sits within the Talent Enablement Team, which designs and delivers the systems, tools, and learning experiences that empower employees to perform, grow, and lead. Talent Enablement defines what great performance looks like, builds the capabilities that enable it, and ensures employees have the clarity, feedback, and development needed to succeed, creating the infrastructure that drives consistency, accountability, and continuous improvement across the organization.

About The Opportunity

The Director, Talent Enablement Program Manager is responsible for translating College Board’s talent strategy into accurate, well-run experiences and decision cycles for employees and managers. This role is accountable for the execution and continuous improvement of cycles such as engagement, rewards, and talent planning, ensuring they are delivered with rigor, clarity, and a strong user experience. Accountable for setting the design direction of these cycles within Talent strategy, the Director brings a clear point of view and recommends how they should evolve.

This role owns and executes the processes with high visibility and the sensitivity of comp-linked and talent decisions, works in close partnership with the Senior Director and Talent leadership, and requires strong judgment and discretion.

We are building towards a tech, data, and AI forward Talent function. As such, in partnership with Talent colleagues, GenAI partners, technology, and data teams, this role helps operationalize lighter-weight, AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort while improving quality.

Core Role Responsibilities

Cycle Design, Execution, and Continuous Improvement (50%)

Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda has 10x'd over the last three years, and the network engineering organization is scaling to match. We're looking for a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to drive our top network infrastructure priorities: bringing network capacity online in new data centers, scaling the fabrics behind our largest GPU clusters, expanding external connectivity, and automating how we plan and deliver the network. Drive end-to-end delivery of Lambda's largest network infrastructure programs, from scoping and planning through execution and handoff to operations, so capacity is always ready ahead of customer demand. Turn ambiguous goals into executable plans with clear scope, milestones, owners and dependencies, including long-lead hardware, vendor and construction timelines

Give senior leadership clear, regular reporting on progress, risks and decisions needed, with a recommendation attached to every escalation
Act as the main connection point between engineering and business teams, so that commitments made to customers and partners match what the network can deliver
Build durable processes for planning, release coordination and change management that hold up as the organization grows
Raise the program management bar across the network organization by mentoring other TPMs and sharing what works

You

Have 7+ years of technical program or technical product management experience, including leading large programs across multiple engineering teams
Have 10+ years of experience working directly with engineering teams
Have 5+ years of hands-on software development or network engineering experience, and can engage credibly on architecture, system design and technical tradeoffs
Have managed programs across cross-functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Understand large-scale data center and cloud networking well enough to spot technical risk, challenge estimates and weigh tradeoffs with engineers
Have a track record of delivering complex infrastructure programs on schedule in fast-paced, high-growth environments

Use data and metrics to run programs and drive decisions

Communicate clearly in writing and in person, and use written documents to frame decisions, align senior stakeholders and get approval on plans

Experience in GPU cloud, HPC, or AI/ML infrastructure environments
Experience with high-performance cluster networking, such as InfiniBand or RoCE-based Ethernet fabrics
Experience with data center buildouts, network hardware supply chain, or long-lead capacity planning
Experience running programs that automate network planning, provisioning or operations
Prior experience at a high-growth infrastructure or cloud company

Scrappiness and adaptability: You get into the details and take practical steps to move work forward. You adjust when priorities change and follow through on what you start
Third-party AI model integration: You’ve led programs that bring third-party AI models into a product and keep them working. You can use evaluation findings and usage data to drive decisions across Engineering, Product, and Partnerships, including tradeoffs around quality, reliability, latency, cost, capacity, and unit economics
AI-enabled process design and automation: Hands-on experience building lightweight processes by leveraging AI workflows, automation, or internal tools
Technical judgment and hands-on problem solving: You can follow a workflow from the user interface through backend services and external model APIs. AI product program delivery and ownership: You’ve led customer-facing technical programs with cross-functional partners, from an ambiguous need through launch and adoption. You judge success by whether the product works for customers and delivers the intended result

You’ve been an early TPM or worked at a startup, where you helped engineering teams plan and ship without adding more process than they needed
You’ve worked with a broad set of model providers, including early-access programs or model migrations
AI research or applied AI program experience is preferred. You’ve partnered with researchers and engineers and used their findings to bring new capabilities into a product. Experience with generative image or video products, and how creative users judge output quality, is especially useful

Why WWT?

World Wide Technology (WWT) strives to make a new world happen. WWT's work benefits clients and partners as much as it does its people and community across the globe.

Founded in 1990, WWT brings together strategy, deep technical expertise and world-class

partnerships to help public and private sector organizations design, build and scale intelligent AI, digital, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure solutions. Through its Advanced Technology Center (ATC)—a collaborative ecosystem featuring state-of-the-art hardware and software—WWT enables clients and partners to conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology and then deploy solutions at scale using its global integration and distribution capabilities.

With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture—grounded in core values and leadership philosophies—has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for its commitment to innovation, trust and creating a great place to work for all. WWT provides products and services to large enterprise, global service provider and public sector clients in up to 130 countries across six continents. Softchoice, a World Wide Technology company, supports commercial and SMB markets in the U.S. and Canada.

Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT today!

Organization Overview

This team designs, builds and operates an AI Factory: purpose-built GPU infrastructure that trains, hosts and serves proprietary models as a commercial service. Unlike correlation-driven models, Causal AI helps customers understand why outcomes occur and what will happen if they change a decision, which makes it valuable for planning, optimization and risk-sensitive use cases.

Our GPU cloud division is a NeoCloud that offers GPU capacity to AI providers.

Why should you join the Office of the CTO?

As the Senior Technical Program Manager, you will sit on the CTO team in our San Francisco office and be accountable for turning the AI Factory roadmap into delivered capacity. You will drive the programs that stand up, expand and modernize the infrastructure behind our Causal AI service and our NeoCloud AI factory builds. You will also be the point of contact for the evolving technical POD of CSEs and Solutions Architects that will engage with AI Factory Organization. You will give the CTO and executive team a clear, honest view of schedule, cost, risk and readiness. Job Description

WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY?

RBC's AI-Driven Software Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) program is scaling across Technology & Operations through a franchise model. A central team owns the method, platform, measurement and playbook. Each L3 (Senior Executive) acts as a franchise, owning local execution, adoption and sustained ownership under a named AI-DLC Lead. With a target of 15,000 staff enabled by mid-FY27, the model depends on clear process and disciplined program management.

As Senior Program Manager, Change & Transformation, you will own delivery of the Franchise Model rollout, reporting to the Delivery & Exec Lead, Live Programs. You will be accountable for moving each L3 from kickoff to steady state on time: entry gates passed, 12-week adoption plan on track, and Central teams delivering what each L3 needs.

You will plan and sequence the rollout, coordinate L3 Leads and Central teams (Change & Learning, Platform, Benefits & Baseline), run the gate and waiver process with Technology ESG, and give decision-makers accurate, timely information. You must be comfortable in a high-visibility environment and able to hold direct conversations with Senior Director-level AI-DLC Leads about unmet gates.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

Rollout Planning: Own the end-to-end L3 franchise rollout plan: sequencing, milestones, dependencies and calendar, from kickoff through steady state.
Entry Gates & Waivers: Drive each L3 through the five entry gates (roles staffed, readiness assessed, plan signed, platform ready, champion layer active) with L3 Leads and Technology ESG. Run the waiver process with a gap, closing date and owner, surface expiring waivers early, and allow no silent renewals.
Adoption & Readiness: Support each L3 through the 12-week adoption plan and readiness assessment, including white-glove or self-serve triage. Flag drift against handbook milestones and agree corrective actions with the Lead.
Central Team Coordination: Coordinate dependencies between L3s and Central teams (Live Programs, Change & Learning, Platform, Benefits & Baseline), and hold each team to its commitments. Resolve cross-L3 conflicts and capacity gaps, or take them to the right forum.
Forums & L3 Front Door: Run franchise forums, kickoffs, training and certification milestones, office hours and Demo Days. Route L3 questions to the right Central team, log them by topic, and track response times.
Tracking & Reporting: Maintain the franchise tracker as the single view of every L3 (gates, milestones, staffing, training, actions). Collect and check monthly funnel and RAG reports, and contribute content to Technology ESG and OC briefings with Lead Operations.
Escalation: Escalate off-track L3s or Central dependencies to the Delivery & Exec Lead and Technology ESG with context and a recommended path, and follow through to resolution. Work with the Program Manager to triage working-level issues.
Continuous Improvement: Capture feedback from L3 Leads, orchestrators and Change Champions, and analyze recurring questions, gate failures and blockers. Keep the handbook, templates and checklists current, and share lessons from early franchises.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?

Must have:

Experience: 8+ years in program or delivery management within large-scale technology transformation, financial services, or enterprise change programs, ideally in a large regulated enterprise with formal governance structures
Multi-Stakeholder Rollout: Proven ability to run a rollout across many business units or teams, holding other leaders to commitments without direct authority.
Senior Stakeholder Management: Credibility to hold direct, candid conversations with Senior Directors and executive sponsors.
Process Discipline & Communication: Strong organization to track many concurrent workstreams, owners and deadlines accurately, with clear, concise written and verbal communication for senior audiences.
Tooling & Independence: Proficiency with JIRA, Confluence, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook, turning raw data into executive-facing views. Comfortable working independently in a vendor or staff augmentation capacity with minimal oversight.

:

Prior experience supporting AI, Agile, or SDLC transformation programs, or familiarity with AI-Native SDLC concepts.
Experience with a franchise, federated, hub-and-spoke or center-of-excellence rollout model.
Experience with change management, training rollout or adoption programs.
Familiarity with benefit measurement or baseline methodology.

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. Practical experience using various agile development tools like Trello, Rally, Atlassian Jira, or project management tools like Microsoft Project
5+ years of experience working as a project manager on IT or application development projects

new_jobs.description:
Description

The IT Project Manager (II)
is responsible for managing the delivery of technology initiatives across Brand Advocacy Solutions (BAS), including AI-enabled solutions, system integrations, enterprise applications, and business technology initiatives. This role serves as the primary delivery lead for assigned projects while also supporting business analysis activities and strategic technology vendor relationships. The position works closely with business stakeholders, product teams, engineering teams, vendors, and leadership to ensure technology solutions align with business objectives and are delivered effectively. Success in this role requires strong project execution, stakeholder management, communication, documentation, and technology partnership capabilities.

Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution (70%)

Project Delivery

Lead end-to-end project delivery across assigned technology initiatives.
Manage multiple concurrent projects with defined scope, schedule, resources, dependencies, and risks.
Ensure alignment across stakeholders and maintain clear project accountability.
Apply the appropriate project management delivery framework, such as Agile, Scrum, or hybrid, best suited to the project.
Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, and reporting artifacts.
Monitor project health and proactively identify and address risks, issues, and dependencies.

Technology Delivery

Manage delivery of AI-enabled tools, automations, and technology initiatives across BAS.
Lead implementation efforts for enterprise applications, system enhancements, and business solutions.
Coordinate testing, deployment, training, launch readiness, and adoption activities.
Support delivery of system integrations across enterprise technology platforms.

Governance & Communications

Maintain project governance artifacts, including project charters, status reports, RAID logs, meeting agendas, meeting summaries, action items, and decision records.
Facilitate project meetings, working sessions, and stakeholder reviews.
Communicate project progress, risks, recommendations, and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership.
Prepare executive-level updates, escalation materials, and decision-support communications.
Drive alignment across cross-functional business and technology teams.

Business Systems Analysis (15%)

Requirements & Documentation

Facilitate discovery sessions and requirements gathering activities with stakeholders.
Document and maintain business requirements, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting project documentation.
Develop and maintain process flows, workflows, business rules, and implementation support materials.
Translate business needs into actionable requirements for technical teams and vendors.

Solution Assessment & Validation

Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for process improvement and technology enablement.
Ensure alignment between business needs and system capabilities.
Support solution evaluation activities and technology recommendations.
Coordinate and support user acceptance testing and requirements validation activities.

Vendor Relationship Management (10%)

Technology Vendor Partnerships

Establish and maintain effective working relationships with strategic technology vendors and partners.
Develop and maintain an understanding of vendor products, capabilities, and service offerings.
Maintain awareness of vendor product roadmaps and upcoming platform enhancements.
Understand how vendor solutions are utilized across BAS operations and client facing programs.

Vendor Engagement

Participate in solution planning and roadmap discussions with technology vendors.
Coordinate issue resolution, escalation activities, and delivery-related vendor communications.
Identify opportunities to leverage vendor capabilities to improve business outcomes and operational effectiveness.
Serve as a liaison between BAS stakeholders and vendor partners when appropriate.

Other Duties as Assigned (5%)

Support special projects, emerging business priorities, and organizational initiatives as assigned.
Participate in continuous improvement efforts and process optimization activities.
Support future growth opportunities related to product ownership, technology strategy, and organizational transformation initiatives.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

3 or more years of experience in IT project management, technology delivery, or related technology leadership roles.
Demonstrated experience managing projects through the full project lifecycle.
Experience coordinating technology implementations, system enhancements, or integration initiatives.
Experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
Ability to create documentation including requirements, process flows, user stories, and implementation materials.
Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, communication, and organizational skills.
Ability to translate business needs into actionable technology solutions.
Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in retail, field operations, agency, or services-based organizations.
Experience supporting business process analysis and solution evaluation activities.
Experience working with third-party vendors, strategic technology partners, or SaaS platforms.
Familiarity with enterprise technologies such as Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform, Salesforce, Oracle, UKG, or similar enterprise systems.
Experience supporting AI-enabled tools, automation platforms, workflow technologies, or Copilot-based solutions.
PMP, Scrum Master, Business Analysis, or related professional certifications.

Additional Requirements

Ability to operate in a cross-functional environment and influence outcomes without direct authority.
Comfort working with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to travel occasionally, estimated up to 10%, to support business meetings, stakeholder workshops, training events, system transitions, and organizational initiatives.

About Us

Acosta Group is a collective uniting the most trusted retail, marketing, and foodservice agencies—Acosta, ActionLink, CORE Foodservice, CROSSMARK, Mosaic, Premium Retail Services, and Product Connections. Together, we connect consumers with the brands they love through omnichannel selling, merchandising, brand advocacy, and integrated marketing.

We recognize our associates are the foundation of our success. That’s why we prioritize your growth, development, and well-being to help you reach your full potential. With programs designed to support a fulfilling work-life balance, we offer opportunities that fit your lifestyle and ambitions—whether you’re looking for part-time flexibility or full-time career advancement.

All-Source Intelligence Analyst

The Opportunity:

With all of the information available today, it takes a skilled all-source analyst to know how to find and interpret the best data to give their clients the right answers. With the critical decisions made in our government and military every day, we need an intelligence analyst like you to do just that. As an all-source intelligence analyst, you use your specialized functional experience and your attention to detail to conduct all-source analytic production on intelligence issues critical to defense.

As an all-source intelligence analyst on our team, you’ll help your client by providing intelligence production and briefing support to address dynamic intelligence requirements. Using your comprehensive understanding of all-source analytic tradecraft, production cycles, publication standards, community writing styles, and formats you’ll produce strategic-level assessments and products that address a specified client area of responsibility (AOR). As an authority on your topic, your client will look to you for comprehensive production, often under pressure.

This is a chance to grow your expertise and broaden your skillset in areas like analysis, writing, and communication. You’ll share your expertise with other analysts through leadership and mentoring. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources to learn new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our warfighters and nation’s leaders.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

Knowledge of IC and Combatant Command environments
Ability to develop high-quality deliverables tailored to senior policymakers or defense stakeholders, including complex written products and formal or informal briefings
TS/SCI clearance
Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of experience in all-source analysis, or 7+ years of experience in all-source analysis in lieu of a degree

3+ years of experience with producing all-source intelligence analysis reports and briefings and inputting data to IC databases
Knowledge of ICD 203 and 206 analytic tradecraft standards

new_jobs.title: Protective Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic’s Global Safety, Intelligence, and Security (GSIS) team is responsible for protecting our people, facilities, and operations worldwide. The function spans intelligence, executive protection, investigations, travel and event security, security operations, environmental health and safety, and crisis management.

We are seeking a Protective Intelligence Analyst to join our GSIS team. In this role, you will play a critical part in identifying, assessing, and mitigating threats to Anthropic's people, facilities, operations, and reputation through intelligence collection, analysis, and dissemination. You'll have the opportunity to help shape the program from the ground up, establishing workflows, analytical standards, and stakeholder relationships that will scale as Anthropic grows.

This role sits at the intersection of intelligence analysis, behavioral threat assessment, and executive protection. You'll produce actionable intelligence that informs security decisions across the organization and operate across the full intelligence cycle, from collection and processing to analysis, production, and dissemination, in a high-tempo environment where the threat landscape is rapidly evolving. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives on the analytical challenge of connecting disparate data points into a coherent threat picture and translating that picture into clear, actionable guidance for decision-makers.

Important Note:
In this position, you may be exposed to graphic and explicit content, including material of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature.

Responsibilities

Conduct all-source intelligence collection and analysis to identify, assess and prioritize physical security threats to Anthropic and its personnel
Produce clear, well-sourced analytical products, from quick-turn updates to in-depth analytical reports for executive delivery
Investigate and triage concerning communications, online threats, and persons of concern using established threat assessment methodologies
Apply behavioral threat assessment principles to persons-of-concern cases, analyzing patterns of concerning behavior, indicators of escalation toward violence, and mitigating factors to guide case disposition and ongoing threat management
Provide intelligence support for executive protection, travel security, and major events, including pre-travel and event briefs, assessments, and real-time threat monitoring
Monitor open-source intelligence channels, social media, deep and dark web forums, and web-based intelligence platforms for emerging threats and risks
Track geopolitical developments and sector-specific threat trends relevant to Anthropic’s global operations and the AI industry
Build relationships with external intelligence partners, law enforcement agencies, and industry peers working on related issues and to facilitate information sharing

You May Be a Good Fit If You

Have 8+ years of professional experience in protective intelligence, corporate investigations, threat assessment, or a related discipline
Hold a bachelor's degree or higher in a relevant field
Have expertise in Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) tradecraft, including proficiency with specialized intelligence tools and social media analysis platforms
Understand how targeted violence develops behaviorally and can recognize and weigh warning behaviors, escalation dynamics, and protective factors when assessing whether a subject is on a pathway toward harm
Have hands-on experience applying established threat assessment methodologies (e.g., TRAP-18, WAVR-21) to analyze and evaluate individuals of concern
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively tailor complex content for various stakeholders, from technical teams to senior leadership
Can manage multiple tasks simultaneously under tight deadlines with minimal oversight
Have a strong drive for continuous process improvement and thrive in highly collaborative environments
Are comfortable with a flexible schedule, including 24/7 on-call rotation and after-hours response, when needed

Strong Candidates May Also Have

Background in high-growth technology companies or startup
Specialized knowledge of risks unique to the AI sector
Professional certifications such as BTAM, CPP, PCI, or relevant intelligence community credentials
Familiarity with privacy law and legal considerations governing intelligence collection in the private sector

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$230,000—$280,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California:
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Join Kellanova as part of a collaborative and data-driven team where business intelligence plays a critical role in shaping commercial decisions across the Modern Trade channel. In this role, you will transform complex sales and market data into actionable insights that support business performance, with a primary focus on Walmart and its formats. Working closely with commercial leaders, you will help ensure the accuracy, consistency, and strategic value of key business indicators.

As a Commercial Business Analyst supporting Walmart & Modern Trade, you will partner with cross-functional teams across Sales, Customer Development, Category Management, Business Intelligence, and Data & Technology. This position offers significant exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to influence commercial strategies through data-driven recommendations, analytical solutions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

A Taste Of What You’ll Be Doing

Drive Commercial Insights: Analyze sales performance across products, categories, customers, and stores to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities that support business decision-making.
Ensure Data Integrity: Validate sales KPIs and maintain consistency across multiple commercial data sources to provide reliable business reporting.
Develop Reporting Solutions: Build, enhance, and maintain dashboards and analytical tools that enable effective tracking of business performance metrics.
Support Strategic Decisions: Deliver ad hoc analyses and recommendations to leadership teams, helping prioritize opportunities and address business challenges.
Optimize Information Processes: Contribute to commercial planning activities while improving data quality, reporting efficiency, and analytical methodologies.

We’re Looking for Someone With

3-5 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Sales Analytics, Revenue Growth Management, Category Management, Customer Development, or related analytical functions.
Experience analyzing sales, product, store, and commercial performance data.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, advanced formulas, and management of large data sets.
Experience validating, reconciling, and ensuring accuracy of sales and commercial data.
Experience working with databases and large volumes of business information.
Experience using sell-out databases, market panels, or external commercial data sources.
Strong analytical capability applied to business problem solving and performance evaluation.

What’s Next

After you apply, your application will be reviewed by a real recruiter, so it may take us a few weeks to get back with you by email or phone. If you join our team, you’ll be rewarded for the difference you make. Our comprehensive benefits offer you the support you need through your life events, big or small.

Need assistance throughout the application or hiring process? Email la.reclutamiento@kellanova.com

Get to Know Us

We’ve always been driven to unleash the full potential of our differentiated brands and our passionate people. Our iconic, world-class brands at Kellanova include Pringles, Cheez-It, Pop-Tarts, MorningStar Farms, Special K, Krave, Zucaritas, Tresor, Crunchy Nut, among others.

Mars, Incorporated has acquired Kellanova in a transaction that brings together iconic brands, storied legacies and outstanding capabilities with a view to shape the future of snacking. You can learn more here, and our hiring teams will be happy to discuss further questions if your application advances in the hiring process.

Let’s shape the future of snacking.
