new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Everforth ECS is seeking a Cyber Threat Analyst II to work remotely.

As a leading managed cybersecurity services provider, ECS delivers a highly tailored and customized offering to each customer. Our team is responsible for protecting ECS corporate and customer networks. Our mission is broad, and our team is agile. You are empowered to engage and lead across multiple groups and must have the self-sufficiency and focus to work well without constant oversight.

Our Tier 2 SOC Analysts are senior, hands-on investigators within the Security Operations Center (SOC). They independently investigate complex threats affecting ECS internal and customer environments, provide incident response support, serve as an escalation point for Tier 1 analysts, and mentor junior personnel. They also conduct SOC threat hunts, support Detection Engineering, and contribute to customer engagements and operational improvements.

This fully remote position supports a 24x7x365 operations environment through assigned SOC shifts, which may include afternoons and weekends. Regular overnight shifts are not required. Participation in an on-call rotation is required and may include overnight incident response and escalations.

Responsibilities

Lead complex investigations escalated by Tier 1 analysts; validate threats, establish incident scope and severity, analyze root cause, and determine appropriate investigative and escalation steps.
Conduct network monitoring and intrusion detection analysis using SIEM, EDR/XDR, SOAR, NDR, intrusion detection/prevention systems, firewalls, and other security tools; triage and escalate alerts in accordance with established procedures.
Correlate network, endpoint, identity, email, cloud, SaaS, and on-premises activity to identify attacks and unauthorized use, including malware, ransomware, business email compromise, account compromise, and insider threats.
Support and conduct incident response investigations, including forensic triage, evidence collection and preservation, attack timeline development, and scope determination. Coordinate containment, eradication, and recovery activities and perform response actions where authorized.
Escalate high-impact, ambiguous, or time-sensitive incidents to Tier 3 personnel and appropriate customer contacts in accordance with established procedures and service-level requirements.
Analyze customer phishing email submissions and suspicious files, URLs, or messages; document findings, recommend actions, and escalate threats in accordance with established procedures.
Submit and track indicator-blocking requests through established Engineering and customer response processes, and coordinate approved containment actions.
Manage assigned tickets through resolution or documented handoff using the MSSP ticketing system; maintain accurate case notes, customer updates, and required response timelines.
Prepare technical incident reports, attack timelines, executive summaries, and customer-facing communications that clearly explain findings and recommended next steps.
Research emerging threats and vulnerabilities, use threat intelligence to enrich investigations, and map observed attacker behavior to MITRE ATT&CK tactics and techniques.
Support and conduct targeted threat hunts based on intelligence, active investigations, customer risks, and detection gaps; document findings and recommend follow-up actions.
Support Detection Engineering by creating, testing, validating, and tuning detection content and investigative queries in accordance with established procedures.
Create and update documentation, security playbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), escalation paths, and investigative guidance.
Actively collaborate with partner teams across the MSSP and customer IT and security teams to support investigations, resolve technical issues, and improve response workflows.
Complete customer ad hoc analysis requests, attend and actively participate in weekly customer meetings, and provide input to quarterly customer QBRs.
Support the development and delivery of ad hoc threat briefings, intelligence reports, and advisories; conduct client knowledge-sharing sessions and support customer-facing engagements.
Submit weekly operational metrics to PMO and provide accurate case information and technical findings for customer reporting.
Support onboarding efforts for new MSSP customers, including customer context, investigation procedures, escalation information, and analyst readiness.
Coach and mentor Tier 1 analysts and interns through case reviews, investigative guidance, technical training, and constructive feedback.
Perform case-quality reviews and operational audits in accordance with established procedures, and recommend improvements to investigation quality and process adherence.
Recommend automation for routine triage tasks and assist in evaluating new analytical techniques, tools, and AI-assisted workflows while maintaining analyst accountability for investigative conclusions.
Participate in assigned SOC shifts and the required on-call rotation to support time-sensitive incidents and after-hours escalations.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

Salary Range: $75,000 - $100,000

Benefits

General Description of Benefits

Required Skills

3+ years of cybersecurity experience, preferably in security operations, incident response, threat detection, or related cyber defense functions.
Demonstrated ability to independently investigate complex security incidents from initial detection through technical analysis, customer escalation, and documented disposition.
Hands-on experience with enterprise SIEM and EDR/XDR technologies, such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Elastic Security, Microsoft Defender XDR, CrowdStrike Falcon, Trellix, SentinelOne, or equivalent platforms.
Working experience with SOAR, security automation, case management, and related investigation technologies.
Possess and maintain a current CompTIA Security+ certification or a higher-level cybersecurity certification that meets applicable compliance requirements.
Strong understanding of Windows and Linux systems, networking, DNS, firewalls, VPNs, email security, web technologies, and endpoint and authentication telemetry.
Experience investigating cloud and identity security activity in one or more environments such as Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, AWS, or comparable SaaS and hybrid-cloud platforms.
Ability to correlate evidence across diverse log sources, develop accurate attack timelines, and apply MITRE ATT&CK and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) to investigations.
Ability to write or adapt investigative queries and detection content using KQL, SPL, Elastic Query Language, Sigma, or comparable technologies; familiarity with alert tuning and detection validation.
Ability to use or adapt scripts and automation with Python, PowerShell, or comparable tools to support investigations and analysis.
Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, written and verbal communication, and decision-making skills; ability to manage multiple concurrent investigations and competing customer priorities.
Good judgment, a sense of urgency, and commitment to high standards of ethics, regulatory compliance, customer service, and business integrity.
U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
Availability to work assigned SOC shifts, participate in required on-call coverage, and travel occasionally to ECS or customer locations as business needs require.

Desired Skills

Experience in a multi-tenant MSSP/MDR, managed services, or consulting environment.
Experience supporting major incidents, conducting proactive threat hunts, and analyzing endpoint, cloud, or identity forensic artifacts.
Experience with SOAR workflow development, automation, AI-assisted investigation tools, or operational process improvements.
Experience validating detections through threat simulation, purple-team activities, or adversary emulation.
Familiarity with malware analysis, cloud-native and containerized environments, and NIST SP 800-61 or comparable incident response frameworks.
Additional cybersecurity certifications such as SEC+, GSEC, SC-200, GCIH, GCIA, CISSP, or comparable certifications.

Job Title: Data and Business Intelligence Analyst

Who We Are

Cahill Contractors is a majority family- and woman-owned general contractor that specializes in the construction of multi-family residential, education, hospitality, and other commercial projects. With offices in San Francisco, Oakland, and San Jose, Cahill works throughout the San Francisco Bay Area. Now in its fourth generation of family leadership, Cahill has been building lasting relationships and quality structures with integrity since 1911. Cahill serves as a trusted partner to our clients, committed to their success from early in preconstruction through construction and beyond. Our employees take tremendous pride in their work and are consistently guided by Cahill’s five core values: Safety, Integrity, Commitment, Collaboration, and Continuous Improvement. Cahill is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Position Summary

The Data & BI Analyst is responsible for keeping Cahill’s data accurate, organized, and usable, and for building the queries, reports, and Power BI dashboards that sit on top of it. This individual maintains the tables, pipelines, and integrations that feed our data warehouse, checks that the numbers match the systems they came from, and turns that data into reporting our project, preconstruction, and accounting teams can trust.

This is an early-career role with room to grow. It works alongside our Operations Team and uses AI tools every day to work faster and smarter. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, curious about how our systems store information, and comfortable explaining technical work to non-technical teammates.

Responsibilities Include

Data Warehouse & Infrastructure

Maintain Cahill’s data warehouse utilizing the Kroo (or similar) connectors, ensuring data integrity, security, and accessibility.
Establish and enforce data governance standards, including naming conventions, documentation, and access controls.
Monitor data warehouse performance and optimize queries, storage, and infrastructure for reliability and speed.
Aggregate additional data sources into a data lake through Fabric (or similar).

Process Improvement & Innovation

Work cross-departmentally with Operations, Preconstruction, Field, Safety, Quality Control, and Accounting teams to identify process bottlenecks and opportunities where AI and automation could streamline workflows.
Document and share lessons learned, success stories, and measurable impact of implemented solutions.

Dashboards & Reporting

Design and build interactive dashboards using Power BI (or similar tools) to provide real-time insights into project performance, financial metrics, scheduling, safety, and other key business indicators.
Partner with stakeholders to define KPIs and reporting requirements that drive informed decision-making.
Maintain and enhance existing reports and dashboards as business needs evolve.

AI Agents & Automation

Design and deploy internal AI agents and automation tools to streamline repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency across departments.
Develop custom AI solutions (e.g., document analysis, predictive analytics, natural language interfaces) tailored to Cahill’s construction workflows.
Integrate AI tools with existing platforms such as project management software, scheduling tools, and communication systems.
Continuously iterate on deployed solutions based on user feedback and evolving business needs.

AI Software Evaluation & Strategy

Research, evaluate, and recommend third-party AI software and platforms for potential adoption across the organization.
Stay current with emerging AI technologies, industry trends, and best practices relevant to the construction sector.
Assist with the development and maintenance of an AI roadmap aligned with Cahill’s strategic goals and Continuous Improvement initiatives.

Training & Support

Provide hands-on training and ongoing support to all departments and employees on the effective use of AI tools and data resources.
Develop training materials, guides, and best-practice documentation tailored to varying levels of technical proficiency.
Serve as one of the go-to resource for AI-related questions, troubleshooting, and adoption support across the company.
Champion a data-literate culture by promoting awareness of how data and AI can enhance day-to-day work.

Desired Skills And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
1–3 years of relevant experience, including internships, coursework, or comparable hands-on work.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases (joins, filtering, aggregation, basic data validation).
Experience building reports or dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable tool, including data modeling, DAX, publishing, and refresh management. Crystal Reports a plus.
Familiarity with Microsoft data tools (Fabric, Azure) preferred.
Experience with construction, accounting, ERP, scheduling, or field operations data (e.g., Viewpoint Vista, Procore, Primavera) helpful.
Quick learner and adaptable problem-solver with strong interpersonal skills, able to work cross-functionally, juggle multiple priorities, and handle confidential information with discretion.

Physical Requirements

The physical requirements described herein are representative of those that must be met by the employee, with or without reasonable accommodation, to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. While performing the duties of this job, the employee occasionally works in an office or hybrid setting. The employee is required to work in compliance with company safety policies, procedures, and applicable laws. This position will be regularly required to:

Repetitively use hand motions for keyboard use and physical use of vision to read computer monitors and paper documents.
Regularly use hands to operate standard office equipment (personal computer, phone, printer, etc.)
See with close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and have the ability to adjust focus.
Sit at a desk for prolonged periods of time working on a computer.
Talk and hear at normal levels. The noise level in the office work environment is usually low to moderate.
Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times, and up to 30 pounds occasionally.

What Can Cahill Offer You?

Employment - This is a full-time position located in downtown San Francisco. This role is hybrid, with a minimum of 3 days in the office. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer an annual discretionary performance-based bonus.
Healthcare Benefits - We provide coverage options with a PPO plan, an HMO plan, including Kaiser. Cahill covers 100% of monthly premiums for employee medical/dental/vision coverage for HMO and PPO plans. Multiple options are available for spouse/partner and family coverage. Additionally, we offer a Medical FSA option.
Retirement - Our 401(k) plan includes significant employer matching and an annual discretionary contribution. We also offer financial advisors to help you plan for your future.
Time Off - We understand the importance of balancing work and personal life. Our flexible PTO package allows you to recharge and take care of life's demands. The position starts with 5 days of PTO already earned and will accrue 3 additional weeks of PTO in the first year.
Volunteer Time Off - We provide paid time-off for volunteering, so our team members can make a meaningful impact to the communities we serve.
Wellness Program Cahill's Wellness Program supports physical, mental, financial, and community well-being with an annual wellness stipend, plus free resources and training.

The base annual salary for this exempt role is targeted between $100,000 - $120,000.

Please view our Privacy Notice (https://cahill-sf.com/privacy-statement/).

Cahill is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Cahill is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position at this time.

new_jobs.title: Protective Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic’s Global Safety, Intelligence, and Security (GSIS) team is responsible for protecting our people, facilities, and operations worldwide. The function spans intelligence, executive protection, investigations, travel and event security, security operations, environmental health and safety, and crisis management.

We are seeking a Protective Intelligence Analyst to join our GSIS team. In this role, you will play a critical part in identifying, assessing, and mitigating threats to Anthropic's people, facilities, operations, and reputation through intelligence collection, analysis, and dissemination. You'll have the opportunity to help shape the program from the ground up, establishing workflows, analytical standards, and stakeholder relationships that will scale as Anthropic grows.

This role sits at the intersection of intelligence analysis, behavioral threat assessment, and executive protection. You'll produce actionable intelligence that informs security decisions across the organization and operate across the full intelligence cycle, from collection and processing to analysis, production, and dissemination, in a high-tempo environment where the threat landscape is rapidly evolving. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives on the analytical challenge of connecting disparate data points into a coherent threat picture and translating that picture into clear, actionable guidance for decision-makers.

Important Note:
In this position, you may be exposed to graphic and explicit content, including material of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature.

Responsibilities

Conduct all-source intelligence collection and analysis to identify, assess and prioritize physical security threats to Anthropic and its personnel
Produce clear, well-sourced analytical products, from quick-turn updates to in-depth analytical reports for executive delivery
Investigate and triage concerning communications, online threats, and persons of concern using established threat assessment methodologies
Apply behavioral threat assessment principles to persons-of-concern cases, analyzing patterns of concerning behavior, indicators of escalation toward violence, and mitigating factors to guide case disposition and ongoing threat management
Provide intelligence support for executive protection, travel security, and major events, including pre-travel and event briefs, assessments, and real-time threat monitoring
Monitor open-source intelligence channels, social media, deep and dark web forums, and web-based intelligence platforms for emerging threats and risks
Track geopolitical developments and sector-specific threat trends relevant to Anthropic’s global operations and the AI industry
Build relationships with external intelligence partners, law enforcement agencies, and industry peers working on related issues and to facilitate information sharing

You May Be a Good Fit If You

Have 8+ years of professional experience in protective intelligence, corporate investigations, threat assessment, or a related discipline
Hold a bachelor's degree or higher in a relevant field
Have expertise in Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) tradecraft, including proficiency with specialized intelligence tools and social media analysis platforms
Understand how targeted violence develops behaviorally and can recognize and weigh warning behaviors, escalation dynamics, and protective factors when assessing whether a subject is on a pathway toward harm
Have hands-on experience applying established threat assessment methodologies (e.g., TRAP-18, WAVR-21) to analyze and evaluate individuals of concern
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively tailor complex content for various stakeholders, from technical teams to senior leadership
Can manage multiple tasks simultaneously under tight deadlines with minimal oversight
Have a strong drive for continuous process improvement and thrive in highly collaborative environments
Are comfortable with a flexible schedule, including 24/7 on-call rotation and after-hours response, when needed

Strong Candidates May Also Have

Background in high-growth technology companies or startup
Specialized knowledge of risks unique to the AI sector
Professional certifications such as BTAM, CPP, PCI, or relevant intelligence community credentials
Familiarity with privacy law and legal considerations governing intelligence collection in the private sector

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$230,000—$280,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California:
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

The Role

Pilot is building a first-of-its-kind, hybrid software/service solution to tackle the financial back office (bookkeeping, tax, CFO, etc.) so founders and business owners can focus on building and running their businesses. We work with thousands of customers in the tech startup and SMB sectors, and we're growing quickly.

Customer Operations is made up of 150+ employees who partner with our customers to manage their financial back office and support their business goals. This is an individual contributor role reporting into the Head of Business Operations, working closely with Customer Operations service delivery teams, cross-functional partners, and peer Business Operations Analysts.

This role sits at the center of how we plan, allocate, and forecast work across the organization, and increasingly, how we automate that work. Pilot is moving fast toward agentic, AI-assisted operations, and this person will build and own the systems, models, and reporting that make that shift possible: work orchestration, KPI reporting, resource forecasting, and billing. This isn't a role for someone who wants to build one dashboard and maintain it. It's for someone who wants to keep building better systems as the work itself changes.

The role requires real fluency with data and automation tools (Excel/Sheets at an expert level, plus a builder's instinct for where AI and scripts can replace manual work), sharp attention to detail, and good judgment about what results imply for our strategy and performance. This person works directly with senior leadership.

This is a hybrid in-office role based in our San Francisco office.

Key Responsibilities

Work Orchestration: Own the systems and processes that plan and allocate work across the organization. Build and maintain the models that route work efficiently as volume, team capacity, and service lines change.
KPI Reporting: Build and maintain reporting that gives leadership a clear, accurate, real-time view of business performance. Know the data well enough to catch anomalies before they become someone else's problem.
Resource Forecasting: Build and maintain forecasting models that project staffing and capacity needs against demand. Translate forecasts into recommendations leadership can act on.
Billing Operations: Own billing sheet accuracy and process, including the reconciliation and QA that keeps them error-free at scale.
Automation & AI Adoption: Identify where manual, spreadsheet-based, or repetitive work can be automated or AI-assisted. Build these solutions directly rather than just recommending them, using tools like Excel/Sheets scripting, SQL, and emerging AI tooling.
Process Optimization: Identify and implement improvements to the processes, workflows, and systems this role owns, so accuracy and efficiency improve as the business changes. Lyntris is a defense technology company that connects sensing to action across the connected battlespace. Lyntris brings together the talents of Accelint and Vitesse teams under one mission, with each contributing deep expertise within their domain. Combining differentiated hardware, software and mission expertise, Lyntris helps customers sense threats, make sense of complex conditions and act with greater speed, precision and confidence in contested environments.

Lyntris supports U.S. and allied defense organizations across every branch — including Navy, Army, Air Force, Space Force and allied partners — spanning strategic, operational and tactical missions and every domain: Space, Air, Land, Sea and Cyber. With more than 200 active defense programs, Lyntris works at every level of the mission, from national command authority to the tactical edge.

Solutions are designed by operators who understand the mission, engineered for the conditions that degrade or defeat standard systems, and built on an open, modular architecture that integrates into existing programs without requiring them to start over. Lyntris moves faster than the traditional defense cycle — with integrated design, build and test capabilities in-house — and delivers systems that sustain and endure long after initial fielding.

Job Description

Senior Business Analyst
Full time
Hybrid (Falls Church, VA)

The Sr. Business Analyst (Systems and Program Support) is a cross-functional business operations professional who integrates business systems, program-management office (PMO) support, operational analytics, and process assurance across Intelligent Systems. The role serves as a primary business-side subject-matter expert for segment processes and helps translate program and functional requirements into reliable data, practical workflows, usable reporting, and measurable improvements.

This is a hands-on problem-solving and execution-support role, not a transactional position or Program Controls authority. The incumbent independently investigates gaps between operating processes and system records, identifies leakage (operational or financial), coordinates implementation, and develops concise, defensible recommendations for internal controls for mitigation and/or improvement. Assignments may include both segment-wide improvements and specifically authorized, customer- or program-focused work.

The incumbent is a force multiplier laterally and vertically within the business until while functional leaders retain their authorities: Finance & Accounting owns accounting treatment and financial records; Program Controls owns designated cost/schedule controls and baselines; P&L Leads and Program Managers own program execution; Engineering and Configuration Management approve technical baselines; Contracts, Procurement, and Property retain assigned approvals and accountability; and IT retains technical system administration and cybersecurity responsibilities. Business Operations coordinates BU business process integration and effectiveness without replacing these authorities.

Duties & Responsibilities

General Program Operations and PMO Support

Provide ad hoc administrative support for initial project planning and execution support to P&L Leads and Program Managers, including project plans, work breakdown structures, implementation schedules, milestone and deliverable registers, dependencies, decision logs, and action trackers.
Assist in development of risk, issue, and opportunity logs; working-level reviews; schedule impact analysis, resources, material readiness, and deliverables; and assist in coordinating assigned mitigation or corrective actions with accountable owners.
Support program reviews, customer status packages, meeting read-aheads, presentation materials, using approved project information and reporting conventions.
Assist in visualization of staffing, workload, utilization, procurement lead times, supplier dependencies, and other execution constraints; recommend resource or workflow improvements without altering approved program baselines or commitments.
Support project initiation, implementation, transition, and closeout; develop reusable PMO templates, checklists, lessons-learned products, and execution practices that can be adopted across multiple programs.

Enterprise Business Systems Enablement

Serve as an ERP system management process SME; gathering requirements, maintaining an improvement backlog, defining and assigning process/data ownership, and coordinating approved configuration or integration changes with designated system authorities.
Develop and implement practical workflows for procure-to-pay, receiving, inventory, asset movement and management; project materials, and controlled business records; conduct user acceptance testing, prepare guides, train users, and verify adoption.
Evaluate system utilization, manual workarounds, duplicate data entry, and gaps between authoritative records and actual operations; recommend and implement scalable, appropriately controlled solutions.

Data Analytics, Visualization, and Leakage

Develop and maintain dashboards, status reporting, and decision-support products spanning procurement, inventory, property, program performance, and operational data.
Research purchase-price or quantity variances, aged or duplicate commitments, incorrect transaction coding, missing material movements, incomplete BOM records, process delays, and other sources of cost, time, or data leakage; quantify exposure with the responsible functional owner.
Work with the Business Financial Manager, Finance & Accounting, and Program Controls to reconcile operational inputs supporting project-cost analysis, EAC/ETC assumptions, management reporting, and program reviews, without independently controlling financial results.

Procurement, Inventory, Property, and Configuration Data

Coordinate with procurement, receiving, Engineering, Property, and program teams to improve purchase and receipt visibility; reconcile inventory quantities, part identifiers, serialized assets, and material transactions in the appropriate systems of record.
Support the controlled reconciliation of approved engineering BOMs, part revisions, configuration status, and inventory or purchasing records; track discrepancies to resolution with authorized technical approvers.
Prepare project-specific material status, traceability, property, inventory, and configuration-data reports and support audit or customer-review readiness where required by an authorized assignment.

Process Assurance, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement

Perform data-quality and process reviews for accuracy, completeness, timeliness, traceability, internal controls, and required approvals; document exceptions, root causes, corrective actions, and effectiveness checks.
Develop SOPs, process maps, swim lanes, workflows, reporting standards, and approved low-code automation (including SharePoint and Microsoft Power Platform) to eliminate preventable rework and support repeatable execution.
Brief executives and cross-functional stakeholders on what changed, why it matters, the operational or financial implications, and recommended next steps; coordinate implementation without assuming another function’s approval authority.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

At least five years of progressively responsible experience spanning business analysis, program or PMO support, business systems, operations analysis, or process improvement.
Experience supporting project planning, risks/issues/actions, resource analysis, and program-performance reporting.
Experience translating business requirements into improved workflows or system implementation, assessing data quality, researching discrepancies to root cause, and coordinating work across multiple stakeholders.
Advanced Excel and practical dashboard/reporting proficiency with Power BI or equivalent tools; ability to prepare concise executive decision products and defensible analyses.
Strong critical thinking, independent judgment, sound prioritization, professional communication, and ability to influence program and functional leaders without direct authority.
Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% to company sites, program locations, and customer activities, based on business needs; ability to meet assigned security/access requirements.
Currently holds an active U.S. national security clearance or be able to receive and maintain one. To learn more about the security clearance process please access this link.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)

Experience with Unanet ERP/AIM, Deltek Costpoint, or a comparable Government-contracting ERP or inventory/property management platform.
Experience in aerospace, defense, Government contracting, engineering, logistics, or other multi-program environments; familiarity with Government property, FAR/DFARS, configuration records, and contract deliverable controls.
Skills with Power Query, DAX, SQL, Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint, Visio, or comparable business-analysis and workflow tools.
Working knowledge of PMO methodologies, project schedules, WBS, risk management, quality assurance, Lean/Six Sigma, or PMI-aligned project practices; relevant PMP, CAPM, or Lean certification beneficial but not required.
Active-duty military experience.

Physical Requirements

Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

This position is hybrid located in Falls Church, VA and typically requires, on-site work of 3 days per week.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst — Energy Retail (Oil & Gas)
new_jobs.description:
About The Role

A hands-on analyst for a consumer energy business: pay-as-you-go cooking gas (LPG) delivered to hundreds of thousands of households in fast-growing emerging markets. You own the analysis end to end — framing the question, getting the data, building the numbers and defending them in front of the people who will act on them. You work directly with commercial, operations, finance and management, and with our founders — no account manager in between.

You join our energy data team, alongside a senior data scientist and a data & BI engineer. A meaningful part of the work starts in raw tables, meter logs, payment exports and field-operations files rather than in a tidy warehouse.

We do not require you to come from oil & gas. The business model is much closer to a prepaid mobile operator than to a fuel station: customers top up credit with mobile money, consume in small amounts, and every unit used is recorded by a smart meter. Experience at mobile network operators, telecoms, mobile money or fintech, utilities with prepaid metering, pay-as-you-go solar, and similar high-volume B2C businesses is directly relevant.

What the work looks like

Each customer home has a stove, a smart meter and a gas cylinder owned and maintained by the company. Customers pay only for the gas they use, topping up as little as a single meal’s worth through mobile money, and local technicians replace cylinders before they run out. That produces rich data — consumption, top-ups, cylinder swaps, deliveries, meter events — and commercial questions to match: which customers stay and why, what a customer is worth, where the network makes or loses money, and what to do about it.

Scope

Customer analytics — acquisition, activation, retention and churn, cohort behaviour, revenue and margin per household, lifetime value against the cost of installation
Consumption and top-up behaviour — frequency and size of top-ups, usage patterns, seasonality, early signs that a customer is about to go dormant
Pricing and promotion analysis — the effect of price, top-up incentives and campaigns on usage and margin, measured against proper baselines and control groups
Field operations and unit economics — cylinder swap and delivery efficiency, depot and area performance, technician productivity, cost to serve per household
Forecasting gas demand, cylinder logistics and revenue by area, to support supply, stock and expansion decisions
Anomaly and fraud detection — meter tampering, consumption that does not match cylinder swaps, payment irregularities, unusual field activity
Reporting with single agreed definitions where commercial, operations and finance count customers, revenue or volume differently
Messy data as the normal case: meter connectivity gaps, delayed payment records, re-assigned devices, data from more than one country and system

Requirements

4+ years as a data analyst or in a comparable analytical role, owning your own analyses from question to recommendation
Experience with high-volume B2C transactional data — prepaid mobile or telecoms, mobile money, utilities, pay-as-you-go energy, retail or similar. You know what subscriber-, account- or transaction-level data looks like and where it lies
Commercial analytics in practice: churn and retention, cohort and lifetime-value analysis, segmentation, pricing or campaign evaluation
Strong SQL and Python (pandas or similar), and readiness to work in raw data yourself: unfamiliar schemas, undocumented tables, exports never meant for analysis
Sound statistics for business questions — baselines, control groups, seasonality, telling a real effect from noise
Working with coding agents, seriously. Agents write most of the code here. Bad agent output in analysis fails silently: a join fans out rows, a filter drops half the active customers, a top-up is attributed to the wrong month. We hire for verification habits, not speed — row-count and population checks, reconciliation against a number someone already trusts, a traceable path from raw data to any figure a decision-maker sees
Experience with a BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, Superset or similar)
Clear communication: you can explain a result, its limits and what to do about it to a non-technical manager
English sufficient to present findings and defend methodology
Professional proficiency in Russian

Nice to have

Experience in emerging markets or with mobile money data
Experience with IoT, smart-meter or device data
Field operations or logistics analytics — routing, depots, delivery efficiency
Experience with experimentation or A/B testing at scale

What we offer

Ownership of customer and commercial analytics, and room to shape how it is done
Direct access to founders and decision-makers; short feedback loops
Generous AI tooling budget — frontier models are a working expense, not a perk
Hybrid working from our London office
Competitive compensation, discussed individually

How to apply

Share your CV and an answer to any of the questions below, at your choice. Applications without answers are not reviewed.

After a top-up bonus campaign in one city, the number of top-ups rose 20%, but gas consumed per household barely changed and revenue per household fell. Marketing calls it a success, finance calls it a loss. How would you work out what actually happened, what data would you need, and what would you deliver?
Give a real case where two teams or two systems reported different numbers for the same customers, subscribers, revenue or churn. What were the figures, why did they differ, which one did the business treat as truth, and what did you change?
Show a real prompt or task brief you gave an agent for an analysis, and what it produced. Then one case where agent output looked right and was numerically wrong: what was wrong, how you caught it, what check you added.
Which transactional or customer systems have you personally pulled data from — billing or CRM at a telecom operator, mobile money or payment platforms, smart-meter or IoT data, POS, ERP? Pick one and tell us something about its data that only someone who has used it would know.

Wie zijn wij?

Kinderen sterker dan oorlog? Absoluut. Maar ze kunnen het niet alleen. Daarom geeft War Child Nederland mentale (nood)hulp aan kinderen in conflictgebieden. Onze werkwijze is gebaseerd op wetenschap. Maar sluit naadloos aan op de belevingswereld van kinderen. We stimuleren hun natuurlijke veerkracht. En verbeteren hun mentale welzijn met unieke en bewezen effectieve methodes. Verpakt als sport, spel en creatieve activiteiten. Zodat kinderen langzaam weer kunnen én durven geloven in de toekomst. Spelenderwijs halen we de oorlog uit een kind.

War Child Nederland Zoekt Een

Data Analyst

"Oplossingsgerichte data expert die cijfers inzet voor impact"

Over de functie

Praktische, oplossingsgerichte Data Analyst die data vertaalt naar acties: je verzamelt, valideert en combineert operationele en financiële gegevens, ontwikkelt gebruiksvriendelijke Power BI‑dashboards en Salesforce‑rapportages, monitort pipeline‑prestaties en forecasts en levert heldere, onderbouwde aanbevelingen en auditeerbare data‑exports zodat management en teams snel en betrouwbaar kunnen sturen op fondsenwerving, projecten en investeringen.

Je bent als Data Analyst onderdeel van het Data team en rapporteert direct aan de Head of Finance, Data & CRM.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Kerntaken en verantwoordelijkheden

Analyseer operationele, fundraising- en financiële data en vertaal inzichten naar heldere, uitvoerbare aanbevelingen voor MT, Fundraising, Finance en Operations.
Ontwikkel, onderhoud en beheer dashboards en rapportagetools (voornamelijk Power BI en Excel) die KPI’s, campagneprestaties, inkomstenprognoses en operationele metrics volgen; zorg voor performance, gebruiksvriendelijkheid en documentatie.
Definieer, documenteer en onderhoud een single source of truth voor funding‑ en operationele KPI’s: eenduidige definities, berekeningsmethoden, eigenaarschap en versiebeheer zodat cijfers vergelijkbaar en betrouwbaar zijn.
Leid de maandelijkse en kwartaalcyclus voor funding performance: verzamel, valideer, reconcilieer en consolideer pipeline‑ en inkomensdata; produceer beknopte highlight‑rapporten en dashboards voor MT en Fundraising.
Monitor pipeline‑conversie en conversiemetrics per donor, campagne en opportunity‑stage; lever forecasting‑inputs en signaleer materiële risico’s en bottlenecks tijdig.
Beheer CRM‑rapportage en geautomatiseerde exports (Salesforce): ontwerp en bouw rapporten, automatiseer exports en integraties met financiële/operationele systemen om handwerk te verminderen; houd audit trails en documentatie bij.
Implementeer en onderhoud datakwaliteitscontroles en validatiechecks; reconcilieer afwijkingen met Finance/CRM en werk samen met Quality Assurance bij compliance‑controles en audit‑voorbereiding.
Bereid gestandaardiseerde, auditeerbare data‑exports en IATI‑compatibele bestanden voor waar nodig voor donorrapportage en audits; zorg dat output voldoet aan donor‑ en organisatienormen.
Ondersteun Fundraising en NL Programme teams technisch en analytisch bij segmentatie, donoranalyse, campagne‑reviews en scenario‑modellering; vertaal analyses naar concrete acties.
Verhoog de datageletterdheid binnen WCNL door trainingen, gebruiksvriendelijke handleidingen en operationele support; faciliteer consistent gebruik van dashboards en rapporten.
Draag bij aan continue verbetering van datamodellen, rapportage‑architectuur en documentatie: identificeer en implementeer automatisering, performance‑optimalisaties en procesverbeteringen.
Vertegenwoordig WCNL bij afstemming met Alliance/Member data‑standaarden: pas relevante definities toe, communiceer WCNL‑behoeften en zorg dat lokale rapportage compatibel blijft met bredere standaarden.
Werk strikt volgens data governance, privacy‑ en safeguarding‑regels; behandel donor‑, partner‑ en beneficiarydata met hoge nauwkeurigheid, vertrouwelijkheid en integriteit.

Jouw profiel

Bachelor of gelijkwaardig werk‑ en denkniveau.
Analytisch, nauwkeurig en kwaliteitsgericht; werkt gestructureerd en met oog voor detail.
Sterke advies‑ en communicatievaardigheden; maakt complexe data begrijpelijk voor niet‑technische stakeholders.
Samenwerkingsgericht en proactief in procesverbetering.
Goede kennis van principes rond data governance, privacy en safeguarding.
Uitstekend schriftelijk en mondeling Engels; Nederlands is een pré.

Ervaring

3–5 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring in data‑analyse en rapportage.
Hands‑on ervaring met Power BI (dashboardontwikkeling, DAX) en gevorderde Excel.
Praktische ervaring met CRM‑rapportage en geautomatiseerde exports/integraties (bijv. Salesforce).
Ervaring met coderen en basis scripting (DAX en/of R; HTML is een pré).
Ervaring met opzetten en uitvoeren van datakwaliteitchecks, reconciliaties en audit‑voorbereiding (inclusief IATI waar relevant).
Ervaring met maandelijkse/kwartaalrapportages voor funding performance, pipeline‑forecasting en management‑dashboards.
Aantoonbare ervaring met het vertalen van analyses naar concrete, uitvoerbare aanbevelingen en het presenteren daarvan aan MT of andere niet‑technische teams.
Ervaring met documentatie en versiebeheer van KPI‑definities, berekeningsmethoden en rapportagestructuren.
Ervaring met fondsenwervingsdatabases of NGO‑fundraisingdata is een pré.

Wat wij bieden

Salaris varieert van € 3.801 tot € 4.727 bruto per maand, op basis van 40 uur per week (het exacte bedrag wordt bepaald door de jaren van je relevante werkervaring);
8% vakantietoeslag op basis van het jaarsalaris;
Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 32-40 uur;
29 vakantiedagen per jaar op fulltime basis (waarvan 3 vooraf vastgestelde vrije dagen);
Een geluksdag, die je spontaan kan inzetten om iets te doen waar je energie van krijgt.
Een volledig door War Child Nederland betaalde pensioenregeling;
Netto tegemoetkoming in de thuiswerk -en reiskosten volgens ons hybride werkbeleid;
Maandelijkse mobiele telefoonvergoeding van €25 netto per maand;
Verschillende secundaire voorwaarden gefocust op persoonlijke ontwikkeling en welzijn;
Goede sfeer, toffe collega's en natuurlijk het betekenisvolle doel van ons werk!

Solliciteren

Wij nodigen je uit om zo snel mogelijk, maar uiterlijk vóór 22 November 2026 te solliciteren.

Upload je CV (maximaal twee pagina’s) en motivatie. Je kan je motivatie delen in Word, PDF of foto-format. Sollicitaties worden overwogen wanneer deze binnen komen en we beginnen met een gesprek zodra geschikte kandidaat(en) solliciteert.

War Child Nederland is een internationale organisatie en we zijn toegewijd om een diverse en inclusieve werkgever te zijn. Wij werven onze nieuwe collega’s op basis van hun talenten, competenties en gedeelde waarden; daarbij letten we niet op de leeftijd, geslacht of genderidentiteit, ras, kleur, etniciteit, geloof, cultuur, seksuele oriëntatie, fysieke beperking, etc.

Veiligheid van kinderen en jeugd is voor War Child Nederland essentieel. War Child Nederland tolereert en accepteert dan ook geen enkele vorm van misbruik. Dit onderwerp komt aan bod in onze werving- en selectieprocedures. Bovendien vragen wij alle geselecteerde kandidaten aan te tonen dat ze op de hoogte zijn van, en zich committeren aan de minimale standaarden die van toepassing zijn in de ontwikkelings- en humanitaire context, zoals humanitaire normen en waarden, Sphere Humanitarian Charter, normen in de Humanitarian Standards Partnership, Core Humanitarian Standard, internationaal humanitair recht, de gedragscode voor het Internationale Rode Kruis en de Rode Halvemaan Beweging, en Goede Doelen (ngo’s) in rampenbestrijding en de 6 IASC basisprincipes ten aanzien van seksuele exploitatie en misbruik.

Disclaimer

Alleen sollicitaties die via onze website binnenkomen, worden in behandeling genomen.
Indien we voor de genoemde sluitingsdatum een geschikte kandidaat hebben gevonden, kan het zijn dat we de vacature eerder dan de vermelde sluitingsdatum van onze website verwijderen. Reacties die na sluitingsdatum binnenkomen, nemen we dan helaas niet meer in behandeling.
De sluitingsdatum kan verlengd worden tijdens ons selectieproces. Indien je nog niets van ons vernomen hebt, nemen we je sollicitatie mee in de verlengde procedure.

Over ons

Onze organisatie

War Child is een dynamische organisatie waar een informele sfeer heerst en waar veel ruimte is voor creativiteit en eigen initiatief. Het imago dat War Child extern uitdraagt, is een blauwdruk van het werk op het hoofdkantoor: het is dynamisch, vernieuwend, integer en gericht op het behalen van resultaten tegen lage kosten. War Child besteedt zoveel mogelijk budget aan het helpen van kinderen in oorlog en doet er daarom alles aan om de kosten zo laag mogelijk te houden. Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn op het niveau van de Nederlandse NGO sector. Het kantoor is gevestigd in de Amsterdamse wijk Watergraafsmeer. We werken in een hybride vorm, met de combinatie van thuis en op kantoor.

Veiligheid

War Child werkt vanuit humanitaire waarden en normen. Van mogelijke nieuwe collega’s vragen we hetzelfde. Voor War Child staat de veiligheid van de kinderen en jongeren die we steunen voorop. We bestrijden elke vorm van misbruik. Omdat we willen dat kinderen en jongeren geen enkel risico lopen komt dit uitgebreid aan bod bij de werving van nieuwe collega’s. About Delinea

Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Data Engineer & Analyst

About The Role

We’re hiring a Data Engineer & Analyst for a hybrid role in Mexico City, with three days per week in the office. You’ll manage data pipelines, build Streamlit in Snowflake apps, and turn operational data into insights for Cloud Engineering and other stakeholders.

What you’ll do

Manage and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Fivetran for ingestion and Airflow for orchestration. This includes onboarding new data sources, building and updating DAGs, monitoring runs, and resolving failures.
Design and build Streamlit in Snowflake apps for incident reporting, alert trends, on-call and operational metrics, and other Cloud Engineering use cases.
Analyze operational data, including incident volume, mean time to resolution (MTTR), and alert noise, and share clear, actionable findings with stakeholders.
Work with existing Snowflake tables and views. When new semantic or aggregate layers are needed, build them according to DSA modeling conventions and submit them for team review.
Follow DSA standards for repository structure, naming, role-based access control (RBAC), secrets handling, warehouse usage, and environment promotion (dev → test → prod).
Use the team’s Git-based CI/CD process, including Snowflake CLI or an equivalent tool, for all pipeline, app, and SQL changes. Manual deployments are not permitted.
Monitor pipeline and app health in Datadog, configure alerts, and respond to data issues in accordance with team engineering practices.
Improve performance and reduce query costs through caching, efficient SQL, and appropriately sized warehouses.
Gather requirements from Cloud Engineering, refine the user experience with users, and deliver improvements in short cycles.
Document apps, pipelines, data dependencies, and runbooks.

Must-have Qualifications

4+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data analytics, including 2+ years of hands-on experience with Snowflake, covering SQL, Snowpark, RBAC, tasks and streams, and warehouse management.
A solid understanding of the Snowflake development lifecycle, including Git workflows, pull requests, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and environment promotion.
Hands-on experience building and managing ETL/ELT pipelines with tools such as Airflow and Fivetran.
Working knowledge of engineering and observability practices, including monitoring, alerting, logging, and incident response, using tools such as Datadog. Familiarity with incident data from PagerDuty, Opsgenie, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar platforms.
Production experience building Streamlit apps, ideally Streamlit in Snowflake.
Strong Python and advanced SQL skills.
A strong analytical mindset, with the ability to translate business questions into metrics and explain findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Comfort working within established team standards and code review processes, and suggesting improvements to them.
Ability to work independently and regularly demonstrate progress.

Nice-to-have Qualifications

Experience with dbt or Snowflake dynamic tables.
Familiarity with Snowflake Cortex, including LLM functions and Cortex Analyst/Search, for querying incident data in plain language.
Prior experience with SRE, cloud operations, or FinOps reporting.
Experience using Terraform to manage Snowflake objects.

Why work at Delinea?

We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.
We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.
What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do
Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments
Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment
Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE

At BECU, data drives decisions, shapes strategies, and creates opportunities to better serve our members. As a Sr Enterprise Data & Business Intelligence Analyst
, you'll play a critical role in transforming complex data into meaningful insights and scalable solutions that support business decisions across the organization.

Collaborate Across Teams: Lead technical discussions, solution walkthroughs, and demonstrations, connecting business objectives with engineering and architecture capabilities.
Champion Best Practices: Establish and maintain technical documentation, business rules, data catalogs, and standardized processes that improve the accessibility and usability of enterprise data.
Mentor and Influence: Share technical expertise, guide fellow BI analysts, and help advance data literacy and analytical capabilities across BECU.
Additional Contributions: Perform additional duties as assigned to support team and organizational objectives.

This isn’t just about ticking off tasks on a list. It's about making a significant, positive change in BECU’s journey, where your contributions are valued, and your growth is continually fostered.

What You’ll Gain

Enterprise-Wide Impact: Influence how data is managed, analyzed, and leveraged across BECU, contributing to solutions that support critical business decisions.
Technical Leadership: Take the lead on complex data initiatives, guide solution design, and serve as a trusted resource for analysts and cross-functional partners.
Advanced Skill Building: Deepen your expertise in enterprise data architecture, cloud technologies, advanced analytics, data modeling, and business intelligence solutions.
Strategic Influence: Work directly with business and technology leaders to shape data solutions that align with organizational priorities and long-term objectives.
Collaborative Innovation: Join a team that values curiosity, problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and new approaches to turning data into meaningful outcomes.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent work or educational experience.
Minimum 7 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, data management, or a related discipline, including advanced experience as a BI power user and data consumer.
Advanced proficiency in SQL, relational and NoSQL data modeling, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Demonstrated ability to bridge business and technical teams, translating complex data requirements into strategic and operational solutions that drive business decisions.
Strong understanding of cloud computing, data engineering principles, and enterprise data architecture, with experience using Azure, DataOps, JIRA, or comparable agile development tools and technologies.
Proven ability to plan, organize, and execute complex data initiatives using established project management methodologies.

Desired Qualifications

Advanced degree in a related discipline.
Advanced proficiency with Python, Alteryx, or similar data manipulation and analytical tools.

Ready to make an indelible impact? Eager to be part of a collaborative and innovative team where your ideas and contributions don’t just fill a role but fuel the growth and success of BECU? Embrace the opportunity to grow with us. Apply now, bring your expertise to the table, and let’s achieve excellence together at BECU. Your journey of influence, innovation, and impactful contribution starts now. #BECU #YourGrowth #BECUJourney

Job Description And Duties

The Department of Industrial Relations, Office of the Director - Research Unit, is responsible for determining the prevailing wage in compliance with the California Labor Code and related regulations. The prevailing rate of per diem wages includes employer payments for health and welfare, pension, vacation/holiday, travel time and subsistence, training, and other payments for similar purposes as determined by the Director of Industrial Relations. The prevailing wage is the minimum rate of pay for workers employed on public works projects.

The Research Data Analyst I (RDA I) is the entry level position and works under the direct supervision of the Research Data Supervisor and performs program elements for which procedures have been developed. Typical tasks include compiling and classifying data from collective bargaining agreements and other sources, preparing and checking statistical tables; writing brief technical notes and drafting text of reports and memos; answering regulated public and external stakeholder inquiries and collecting data by written correspondence and telephone. The analyst may also be called upon to conduct surveys including the design of questionnaires; revising tables applying user-oriented programming techniques.

This posting may be used to fill future vacancies in accordance with 2 CCR

249.3

.

455 Golden Gate Ave. 9th Floor,

San Francisco, CA 94102

Job Profile:

Research Analyst I

Job Summary:

The Department of Urology is seeking a Research Analyst I to join their team! This position will perform retrospective clinical research in the sub-specialty of urologic oncology with a focus on kidney cancer, under the direction of physician-scientist E. Jason Abel, MD in the Department of Urology. This work helps advance life-saving clinical treatments. Our nationally recognized department provides the latest treatments for urologic conditions, identifies new breakthroughs, and trains the next generation of physicians.

This position is full or part-time, 60%-100%
This position requires work to be completed onsite, at a designated campus work location.
Candidates who demonstrate the following knowledge, skills, and abilities will be given first consideration
Experience with clinical research
Knowledge of database software
Excellent written and verbal communications skills
Strong computer skills including experience with Microsoft Word and Excel
High attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to work independently and collaborate with other researchers when necessary
Strong organization and prioritization skills

Key Job Responsibilities:

Abstract pertinent data from patient medical records
Prepares reports and manuscripts and assists with the development and presentation of materials through various communication platforms
Analyzes data and summarizes research results for a defined research area or study by utilizing established processes
Serves as an initial point of contact for individuals and groups providing basic information about result analysis and methodologies, answers questions as needed
Maintains organization of research records and responds to data requests and inquiries

Department:

School of Medicine and Public Health, Department of Urology, Abel Lab

Since the 1920s, the Urology Program at the University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health has had the tradition of providing technologically advanced urologic care for the people of Wisconsin and beyond. Today, we retain the principles of the past and have moved our efforts toward providing state-of-the-art urologic care for present and future generations.

Our highly acclaimed program focuses on cutting-edge surgical care for adult and pediatric urologic patients while conducting innovative research and training the next generation of academic urologists. Our Department consists of all major subspecialties, including Urologic Oncology, Endourology, Men’s Health, Pediatric Urology, Women’s Pelvic Wellness, Andrology/Infertility, and Urinary Reconstruction programs.

The starting salary for the position is $60,000 annually; but is negotiable based on experience and qualifications.

Employees in this position can expect to receive benefits such as generous vacation, holidays, and sick leave; competitive insurances and savings accounts; retirement benefits. For more information, refer to the campus benefits webpage.SMPH Faculty /Academic Staff Benefits Flyer 2026

Knowledge of database software

Strong computer skills including experience with Microsoft Word and Excel

Bachelor's Degree Preferred Minimum in health sciences or related field

new_jobs.title: KM Legal Research Analyst
new_jobs.description:
As a member of the Knowledge Management & Innovation Department, the KM Research Analyst conducts sophisticated legal and non-legal research to respond to firm-wide reference and research requests from attorneys, administration and staff.

Please note: this position will operate from 9/9:30am - 6/6:30pm Eastern Time

Essential Functions

Monitors workflow; responds and completes department requests.
Provides comprehensive legal and business research using a variety of on-line and print resources, including proper use of AI tools.
Conducts complex substantive legal research, precedent document searching, expert witness research, legislative history research, judicial research, docket, and analytics searching.
Creates targeted, custom alerts to monitor developments in the law, docket tracks, and litigation searches.
Precisely, intelligently, and promptly communicates the results of research requests to the requestors.
Provides general support for KM research tools and resources (i.e. Westlaw Precision, Practical Law, and other related platforms).

Additional Functions

Works on special projects (i.e., collection development) as assigned.

Education

QUALIFICATIONS (EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES):

Bachelor’s degree in related field required. Masters in Library & Information Science or Juris Doctor a plus.

Experience

Minimum of three years of legal and business research experience in a legal, corporate or professional services environment.
Experience using AI tools a plus.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Thorough and advanced knowledge of legal research and general business research
Knowledge of and ability to use on-line resources including AI functionality within tools. Resources include: Westlaw Precision/Practical Law with AI modules, Bloomberg Law, PACER, and other types of web-based services, including IP, corporate and securities research tools as well as the Microsoft suite of products.
Ability to synthesize relevant information needed for high-level decision making.
Excellent communication skills with particular emphasis on written communication
Ability to multitask, manage time, establish priorities, respond to emergencies and deal with individuals with patience and diplomacy.
Ability to maintain a service-oriented attitude, remaining poised under pressure.
Self-motivated, detail oriented and organized with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

This job operates in a clerical, office setting. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

Physical Requirements

Sedentary work: Exertion of physical strength to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects up to 10 pounds. Work involves sitting most of the time. Walking and standing is often necessary in carrying out job duties.

Compensation & Benefits

The salary ranges for this position apply to the respective listed locations. The salary range reflects a variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to experience, education, licensure and/or certifications, geographic location, market demands and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for a position. Reasonable estimates of the current ranges for this position are:

Atlantic City, Chicago, Minneapolis: $44.23 - $49.04/hr.
Morristown, Princeton, Washington DC: $45.67 - $50.50/hr.

For information on Fox Rothschild's compensation and benefits visit: Compensation & Benefits (foxrothschild.com)

Fox Rothschild LLP is under no obligation to provide sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis now and in the future.
